arxiv-2005-02557.title: Crossing Variational Autoencoders for Answer Retrieval
arxiv-2005-02557.creator: Wenhao Yu, Lingfei Wu, Qingkai Zeng, Shu Tao, Yu Deng, Meng Jiang † {\dagger} University of Notre Dame, Notre Dame, IN, USA ‡ {\ddagger} IBM Thomas J. Watson Research Center, Yorktown Heights, NY, USA † {\dagger} {wyu1, qzeng, mjiang2}@nd.edu ‡ {\ddagger} {wuli, shutao, dengy}@us.ibm.com
arxiv-2005-02557.description: Abstract Answer retrieval is to find the most aligned answer from a large set of candidates given a question. Learning vector representations of questions/answers is the key factor. Question-answer alignment and question/answer semantics are two important signals for learning the representations. Existing methods learned semantic representations with dual encoders or dual variational auto-encoders.

arxiv-2106-10930.title: Unbalanced clustering and solitary states in coupled excitable systems
arxiv-2106-10930.creator: Igor Franović, Sebastian Eydam, Nadezhda Semenova, Anna Zakharova
arxiv-2106-10930.description: Abstract We demonstrate the mechanisms of emergence and the link between two types of symmetry-broken states, the unbalanced periodic two-cluster states and solitary states, in coupled excitable systems with prevalent repulsive interactions. Solitary states in non-locally coupled arrays inherit their dynamical features from unbalanced cluster states in globally coupled networks.

arxiv-2107-14386.title: Inelastic electron transfer in olfaction: multiphonons processes
arxiv-2107-14386.creator: Shu-Quan Zhang, Yu Cui, Xue-Wei Li, Yong Sun, Zi-Wu Wang*
arxiv-2107-14386.description: Abstract Inelastic electron transfer being regarded as one of the potential mechanisms to explain the odorant recognition in the atomic-scale processes is still a matter of intense debate. Here, we propose multiphonon processes of electrons transfer using the Markvart’ s model and calculate their lifetimes with values of key parameters widely adopted in olfactory systems.

arxiv-2203-04573.title: Reinforced Meta Active Learning
arxiv-2203-04573.creator: Michael Katz, Eli Kravchik
arxiv-2203-04573.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Michael Katz, Eli Kravchik. In stream-based active learning, the learning procedure typically has access to a stream of unlabeled data instances and must decide for each instance whether to label it and use it for training or to discard it. There are numerous active learning strategies which try to minimize the number of labeled samples required for training in this setting by identifying and retaining the most informative data samples.

arxiv-2207-09945.title: Casimir Wormholes in Modified Symmetric Teleparallel Gravity
arxiv-2207-09945.creator: Zinnat Hassan, Sayantan Ghosh, P.K. Sahoo, Kazuharu Bamba
arxiv-2207-09945.description: Abstract In recent years there has been a growing interest in the field of Casimir wormhole. In classical general relativity (GR), it is known that the null energy condition (NEC) has to be violated to have a wormhole to be stable.

arxiv-2302-04133.title: Isometric embeddings of surfaces for scl
arxiv-2302-04133.creator: Alexis Marchand
arxiv-2302-04133.description: Abstract . Let φ : F 1 → F 2 \varphi:F_{1}\to F_{2} be an injective morphism of free groups. If φ \varphi is geometric (i.e. induced by an inclusion of oriented compact connected surfaces with nonempty boundary), then we show that φ \varphi is an isometric embedding for stable commutator length.

arxiv-2311-04559.title: Individual and gender inequality in computer science: A career study of cohorts from 1970 to 2000
arxiv-2311-04559.creator: Haiko Lietz, Mohsen Jadidi, Daniel Kostic, Milena Tsvetkova, Claudia Wagner
arxiv-2311-04559.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Haiko Lietz, Mohsen Jadidi, Daniel Kostic, Milena Tsvetkova, Claudia Wagner. Inequality prevails in science. Individual inequality means that most perish quickly and only a few are successful, while gender inequality implies that there are differences in achievements for women and men. Using large-scale bibliographic data and following a computational approach, we study the evolution of individual and gender inequality for cohorts from 1970 to 2000 in the whole field of computer science as it grows and becomes a team-based science.

arxiv-2409-12857.title: A characterization of inner product spaces via norming vectors
arxiv-2409-12857.creator: Guillaume Aubrun, Mathis Cavichioli
arxiv-2409-12857.description: Abstract . A finite-dimensional normed space is an inner product space if and only if the set of norming vectors of any endomorphism is a linear subspace. This theorem was proved by Sain and Paul for real scalars. In this paper, we give a different proof which also extends to the case of complex scalars.

arxiv-2411-09689.title: Probing LLM Hallucination from Within: Perturbation-Driven Approach via Internal Knowledge
arxiv-2411-09689.creator: Seongmin Lee, Hsiang Hsu, Chun-Fu (Richard) Chen, Duen Horng (Polo) Chau
arxiv-2411-09689.description: Abstract LLM hallucination, where unfaithful text is generated, presents a critical challenge for LLMs’ practical applications. Current detection methods often resort to external knowledge, LLM fine-tuning, or supervised training with large hallucination-labeled datasets. Moreover, these approaches do not distinguish between different types of hallucinations, which is crucial for enhancing detection performance.

arxiv-2512-15440.title: Lithium-ion battery degradation: Introducing the concept of reservoirs to design for lifetime
arxiv-2512-15440.creator: Mohammed Asheruddin Nazeeruddin, Ruihe Li, Simon E. J. O’Kane, Monica Marinescu, Gregory J. Offer
arxiv-2512-15440.description: Abstract Context & scale Lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) are the backbone of electrified transport and grid-scale energy storage. Commercial designs often target energy densities of 250–300 Wh/kg, yet these gains are increasingly undermined by limitations in service life—with capacity fade often exceeding 20% within 500–1,000 cycles under realistic charging, discharging, and thermal conditions.

pmc-11510016.title: Formulating Electrolytes for 4.6 V Anode-Free Lithium Metal Batteries
pmc-11510016.creator: Jiaojiao Deng, Hai Lin, Liang Hu, Changzhen Zhan, Qingsong Weng, Xiaoliang Yu, Xiaoqi Sun, Qianlin Zhang, Jinhan Mo, Baohua Li, Songhun Yoon
pmc-11510016.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). High-voltage initial anode-free lithium metal batteries (AFLMBs) promise the maximized energy densities of rechargeable lithium batteries. However, the reversibility of the high-voltage cathode and lithium metal anode is unsatisfactory in sustaining their long lifespan. In this research, a concentrated electrolyte comprising dual salts of LiTFSI and LiDFOB dissolved in mixing solvents of dimethyl carbonate (DMC) and fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) with a LiNO3 additive was formulated to address this challenge.

pmc-11533604.title: Molecular detection and phylogeny analysis of Coxiella burnetii detected from cattle and buffalo milk based on plasmid cbhE gene in West Azerbaijan of Iran
pmc-11533604.creator: Peyman Khademi, Amir Tukmechi, Abdulghaffar Ownagh
pmc-11533604.description: Humans and animals may get Q fever, which is caused by the Gram-negative coccobacillus Coxiella burnetii. The symptoms of Q fever may include a self-limiting febrile illness, pneumonia, endocarditis, or hepatitis. Infections are classified as either acute or persistent. Cattle, sheep, and goats are the most prevalent reservoir animals for this zoonosis. This research was conducted to identify C.

pmc-11655072.title: LONG-TERM SURVIVAL AFTER LAPAROSCOPIC TOTAL GASTRECTOMY FOR EARLY AND ADVANCED GASTRIC CANCER. SINGLE CENTER EXPERIENCE IN 100 CASES
pmc-11655072.creator: Enrique NORERO, Marco CERONI, Cristian MARTINEZ, Rodrigo MUÑOZ, Ricardo MEJIA, Emilio MORALES, Ignacio OBAID, Paulina GONZALEZ
pmc-11655072.description: BACKGROUND:Laparoscopic gastrectomy offers advantages in the postoperative period compared to the open approach. Most studies have been performed on distal gastrectomies; however, laparoscopic total gastrectomy (LTG) is not universally accepted. AIM: The aim of this study was to assess the results of LTG, on postoperative morbidity outcomes and long-term survival.

pmc-13085392.title: Understanding the family caregivers’ needs in late-stage dementia: a qualitative perspective to inform policy action
pmc-13085392.creator: Silvia Gonella, Paola Di Giulio, Jacopo Maria Olagnero, Daniele Quaranta, Giulia Nagliati, Valerio Dimonte, Sara Campagna
pmc-13085392.description: BackgroundDementia places substantial burden on family caregivers due to its irreversible and progressive nature. Prior research mainly explored family caregivers’ needs in the early- and middle-stage of dementia. However, as dementia progresses, caregiving demands intensify and caregivers’ needs evolve, often contributing to nursing home (NH) admission. Assessing needs across the disease trajectory is essential for designing tailored interventions.

pmc-13487189.title: How Defining ‘Disadvantaged’ Shaped Bipartisan Infrastructure Law Drinking Water Funding
pmc-13487189.creator: Samyukta Shrivatsa, Derek Ouyang, Daniel E Ho, Khalid K Osman
pmc-13487189.description: The 2021 Bipartisan Infrastructure Law (BIL) directed $30.7 billion specifically towards safe drinking water programs, representing the single-largest investment into water infrastructure in United States history. The law mandates that 49% of funds be provided as grants and forgivable loans to “disadvantaged communities.

pmc-13553705.title: Light-Based Therapies for Metabolic Modulation of Mesenchymal Stem Cells in Regenerative Dentistry
pmc-13553705.creator: Ygor Gonçalves Felix de Mattos, Otávio Augusto Alfonso Morais de Melo, José Ricardo Muniz Ferreira, Jamil Awad Shibli, Letícia Mello Bezinelli, Fernanda de Paula Eduardo, Alessandra V. S. Faria, Daniela Franco Bueno
pmc-13553705.description: Periodontal diseases and temporomandibular disorders are characterized by chronic inflammation and progressive destruction of supporting tissues, leading to functional and aesthetic impairments. In this context, regenerative dentistry has increasingly focused on minimally invasive strategies capable of restoring tissue structure and function.
